pr_title: Alert unpushed commits when merging a pull request
pr_body:
Fixes #969

I added comparing the last local commit with the pull request's last commit to see if the unpushed commit is on the local branch.

* For strictly checking, we should check the last local commit hash for every commit pushed. However, this seems to be expensive to search. So I implemented simple commit check and branch check (the alert message says `may have`).
* I added many `cs.Stub("")` to tests. It looks like verbose code, but I can't simplify these ...
  * It looks weird that some tests in merge_test.go don't need to add stub codes 🤔
pr_comments:
giving this to @samcoe to:

- fix conflicts
- disable this check if -R was used

issue_context.title: Alert user if there are unpushed commits on the branch they are merging.
issue_context.body:
This was brought up by @vilmibm in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/899#pullrequestreview-414754076

> I fixed the merge conflict locally and instinctively ran gh pr merge again, still getting the merge conflict error because I hadn't pushed. A future follow-up might be to notice that 1) the PR is question is the "current" PR and 2) there are unpushed commits and then reporting that to the user ("! Unpushed commits for pull request 123")
comments: I would like to work on this.

review_comments: When `selectorArg` is empty we use the current local git branch to retrieve the PR so there is no need to recheck if the PR branch name matches the local git branch name.
